changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Hide unreleased titles can now wait for a movie's digital release, not only cinemas.

changes.label: Bugfix
changes.text: Show Stremlist titles in the Board Spotlight.

changes.label: Bugfix
changes.text: Accept film IDs in list pages.

changes.label: Bugfix
changes.text: Keep legacy cache after transient refresh failures.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Add "New titles" from Quick add, then rename, move, filter and preview it like your other Lists. Sort titles by when Stremlist found them or when they came out.

changes.label: Compatibility
changes.text: If you link the main account for your Stremio Supporter profiles, Stremlist updates the addon on each profile where you installed it with the same Addon URL.

changes.label: Bugfix
changes.text: Trakt Up Next now shows only series where you watched at least one episode.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: In Options, choose what to share from your linked Stremio account with Trakt, Simkl or MDBList. For each Connection, you can send watched marks, add new library titles to your watchlist, or do both.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: When Stremio sends a library addition, Stremlist checks the title's current status on Simkl before adding it to Plan to Watch. This keeps titles you already started or finished in their current lists.

changes.label: Bugfix
changes.text: Open supported Source lists on their Provider directly from your saved Lists. Links to your Trakt lists now open the correct Trakt pages.

changes.label: Enhancement
changes.text: Trakt Up Next now leaves out series you dropped or hid from your watched progress.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Sort any List by release date, newest or oldest first. For Trakt Up Next, this uses the date of the latest aired episode.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Use "Hide unreleased titles" to leave upcoming movies and series out of a List's Catalogs.

changes.label: Enhancement
changes.text: A Stremlist Account can now hold up to 50 Lists and 50 Source lists.

changes.label: Performance
changes.text: Stremlist prepares more Catalogs in parallel after you save, so large setups are ready sooner.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: Fixed a check that could flag valid code before release.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: A single refused Letterboxd request now affects only that read. Stremlist waits for repeated refusals before it pauses Letterboxd refreshes.

changes.label: Enhancement
changes.text: Quick add now shows one Provider's Lists at a time and opens the most recently connected Provider first. You can open a Source list on its Provider when a link is available.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Quick add offers more Simkl charts for movies, TV and anime, including daily and monthly trends, monthly trends by genre, and DVD releases. Connect Simkl to add your Airing Soon and Continue Watching lists.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Connect MDBList to add Up Next, your collection, recommendations and more official charts, including weekly Most Watched and JustWatch Streaming Charts.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Connect Trakt to add Continue Watching, your personal calendar, and lists you like or help manage. You can also add public calendars for new shows, season premieres, upcoming movies and DVD releases.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Add SensCritique lists for titles in progress, titles a member recently liked, or titles they watched in a specific year. You can also add the Top 111 anime chart and a member's ranking in a poll.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: Maintenance update to speed up the checks that run before a release.

changes.label: Bugfix
changes.text: The full Catalog preview shows placeholders while it loads more titles, so the window stays the same size as they appear.

changes.label: Compatibility
changes.text: The configure page now loads saved Lists when you run Stremlist locally over HTTP.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Select the "+N more" tile in a Catalog preview to browse every title in that Catalog. More titles load as you scroll.

changes.label: Performance
changes.text: The full Catalog preview stays responsive as you scroll through thousands of titles.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: A blocked Letterboxd member film page now affects only its own List. That List keeps its last successful Catalog, and other Letterboxd Lists can still refresh.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: When a Letterboxd watchlist goes private, Stremlist clears its Catalog and lets other Letterboxd Lists refresh.

changes.label: Bugfix
changes.text: The Stremio preview on the home page shows more posters to fill its rows on wide screens.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: Watch tracking can now send the watched mark for the episode you just finished when you open streams for the next one.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: Stremlist avoids duplicate and false alerts when Letterboxd refreshes pause or resume.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Choose IMDb, TMDB, TheTVDB or RPDB as the poster source for your Catalogs. Open "Examples" to compare posters before you save.

changes.label: Enhancement
changes.text: The example posters appear in one row that you can scroll sideways on any screen.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: Stremlist now checks individual types of Source list, so it can detect a problem even when other Lists from that Provider still load.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Connect MDBList to add your ratings, watch history and liked lists, plus official charts for trending, popular, anticipated and most-watched titles. Watch history includes series you started and have yet to finish.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Add Simkl's weekly Trending Movies, TV and Anime charts from Quick add without a Connection.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Connect Simkl to add the movies, series and anime you rated.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Add SensCritique links for watched titles, ratings, favorites and poll results. Quick add also offers the Top 111 and Top 100 charts for movies and series.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Paste a public IMDb ratings link to add a Catalog of up to 10,000 of that user's most recent ratings.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Add IMDb's Bottom 100 and its Top 250 movie charts for English, Indian, Tamil, Telugu and Malayalam films.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Add Trakt favorites or ratings from your Connection or from a public profile. You can also add a public profile's watch history or collection, the box office, and more weekly charts.

changes.label: Bugfix
changes.text: Trakt watch history and collections now include titles beyond the first page.

changes.label: Bugfix
changes.text: On a touch screen, drag a List by its handle as soon as you move your finger. You no longer need to press and hold.

changes.label: Enhancement
changes.text: On mobile, use "Move up" and "Move down" to change the order of your Lists.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: Stremlist reads the SensCritique status page more reliably when it checks for outages.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: The configure page now shows a banner when a Provider has an outage. It uses the official status pages of Trakt, Simkl, MDBList and SensCritique as well as Stremlist's own checks.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Paste a public Trakt smart list link to add it as a Catalog, or connect Trakt to add your own smart lists, including private ones. Stremlist keeps the top 1,000 titles in Trakt's order.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: Stremlist retries a SensCritique request once if it times out, so a brief timeout is less likely to interrupt a refresh.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Stremlist now reads more than IMDb. Add watchlists and lists from Trakt, Simkl, MDBList, JustWatch, SensCritique and Letterboxd, next to your IMDb watchlist and lists.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Connect your Trakt, Simkl or MDBList account to read your private lists. If a connection expires, the list shows it and you can connect again in one click.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Letterboxd support includes watchlists, lists, watched films, diary, likes, share links and boxd.it short links.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Merge up to 5 lists into one catalog. Titles that appear in more than one list show only once.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added an optional "New titles" catalog that shows the titles recently added to any of your lists.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Preview the catalogs of a list before you save it, including the entries that Stremlist could not match to a title.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Each list now shows when it last synced and why a sync failed. The configure page also tells you when you must reinstall the addon in Stremio after a save.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Redesigned the home, configure, changelog and terms pages, with Quick add for popular charts.

changes.label: Compatibility
changes.text: Stremlist works in Nuvio. The Install button opens Nuvio, and your Lists, sort options, filters and search show as in Stremio.

changes.label: Compatibility
changes.text: Addons installed with your IMDb user ID keep working. Open your configure page to add the new sources.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added per-catalog filters for genre, decade, maximum runtime, and minimum IMDb rating. Combine them to narrow down what you want to watch.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added title search for your catalogs in Stremio, including accent-insensitive matching. Your saved filters also apply to search results.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added optional "90 min or less", "Top rated", and "Shuffle" catalogs in Stremio. Enable them under "Filters & extra catalogs", save, and reinstall the addon to show the new catalogs.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added filters and sorting options in Stremio's catalog dropdown, including shortest or longest runtime and newest or oldest release date, without changing your saved settings.

changes.label: Bugfix
changes.text: Fixed TV episode selection when Stremlist is listed before other metadata addons. Series details now come from another installed metadata provider, while your series catalogs stay available.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: Watchlists and your RPDB key now save together, so a failed save cannot leave only part of your configuration updated. Save failures also show a clear error message.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Increased support for IMDb watchlists and lists from 10,000 to 15,000 titles.

changes.label: Performance
changes.text: Catalogs start preparing in the background after you save your configuration, reducing the wait when you next open them in Stremio.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: Improved handling of simultaneous refresh requests and added clearer feedback when configuration loading or catalog refreshes fail.

changes.label: Performance
changes.text: Reworked catalog caching to store large watchlists more efficiently and reuse saved results without fetching IMDb again.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: Improved recovery from stale cache entries and made cache replacement and deletion safer when requests overlap.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added built-in IMDb chart catalogs: add Most Popular and Top 250 Movies & TV, the weekend Box Office, and Coming Soon releases as ready-made catalogs, no IMDb account required.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added a per-catalog "Show" option so each watchlist or list can display movies only, TV shows only, or both.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added a "Refresh now" button on the Configure page to pull your latest IMDb watchlist on demand, with a "Last refreshed" label and a short cooldown between refreshes.

changes.label: Performance
changes.text: Catalogs are now served cache-first, so a fresh watchlist loads from a single fast lookup with no live IMDb fetch. This makes catalogs noticeably quicker and more resilient.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: Private or unavailable watchlists now show a clear informational card explaining why the catalog is empty instead of failing, and metadata is served from cache to stop Stremio from retry-storming during IMDb outages.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added support for IMDb lists (ls-prefixed IDs) alongside watchlists, so you can now add any public IMDb list as a catalog.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added drag-and-drop reordering for catalogs on the Configure page, making it easy to arrange your catalogs in your preferred order.

changes.label: Reliability
changes.text: Fixed recurring backend downtime caused by the previous scraping approach by rebuilding the IMDb scraping flow for better stability.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added RPDB poster support for improved artwork in catalogs.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added support for multiple IMDb watchlists in a single setup.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added a new "Random" sort order.

changes.label: Open source
changes.text: Open-sourced Stremlist to make community contributions and transparency easier.

changes.label: Architecture
changes.text: Rebuilt deployment around Vercel (frontend + API), replacing the old self-managed Linux VPS setup for simpler operations, easier rollouts, and better uptime.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added "Date Added" sorting options to display watchlist items in the order they were added to IMDb (oldest first or newest first).

changes.label: Enhancement
changes.text: Changed default sorting to "Date Added (Oldest First)" which preserves the natural order from IMDb.

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Added comprehensive sorting functionality: users can now sort their watchlists by title (A-Z/Z-A), year (newest/oldest first), or rating (highest/lowest first). Sort options are available both during initial setup and in configuration, with preferences persisted consistently across installations.

changes.label: Enhancement
changes.text: Added specific error message for private IMDb watchlists

changes.label: Bugfix
changes.text: Improved error messaging to provide clearer guidance when issues occur

changes.label: Performance
changes.text: Replaced HTML scraping with direct GraphQL API calls to improve reliability and efficiency

changes.label: Bugfix
changes.text: Fixed issue where posters and titles were displayed in French instead of English

changes.label: Enhancement
changes.text: Increased the watchlist item limit from 250 to 10,000 items

changes.label: Enhancement
changes.text: Initial release of Stremlist

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Connect IMDb watchlist to Stremio through user ID

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Automatic refresh of watchlist data every 6-12 hours

changes.label: Feature
changes.text: Support for movies and TV series from IMDb watchlists
